scope:
A pause survives a rollback attempt: the schema-23 daemon records a hold,
an installed schema-22 daemon refuses to open that state, and the hold is
still there for the 23 daemon. Private home; never the production state.
steps: schema-23 daemon paused the project: paused aef60cbc5ffb — rollback trial hold; agents there take no new leases until `agentdocker pause --lift`
state.db at schema 23 with one pause document
schema-22 daemon refused to start (exit 1); state.db unchanged (sha256 e352e94e548a), pause document retained
schema-23 daemon reopened the state and still lists the hold
the person lifted it; nothing paused
old_daemon_refusal: Error: state database has schema version "23"; this build expects 22
